title: Button
description: Buttons for primary actions, secondary actions and destructive actions, with disabled and loading examples.
usage: One primary action per view. Use Secondary for the alternative, Ghost for tertiary actions, Danger only for destructive ones.
a11y: Native buttons with explicit types and a focus-visible ring using --k-ring. Each color variant has hover and pressed styles; disabled examples use the native disabled attribute. Loading examples retain their text and use disabled with aria-busy. Decorative spinners are aria-hidden and stop with prefers-reduced-motion. btn-asagi is a deprecated alias of btn-accent. No JavaScript is required.
